transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Uh... I guess I'm just having some issues at work lately. I supervise a sales team, and... I don't know, I just keep making these dumb mistakes on the sales reports. Like copying the wrong numbers down from the team dashboard, or missing a line in a procedure I was supposed to check. Even when I thought I already went over it. So... yeah. That's mainly it.
Do you find yourself having trouble focusing or paying attention to details at work?

Yeah... I mean, like I just said. It's mainly the reports. I try to focus, but I still end up pulling the wrong numbers from the dashboard, or... skipping a line when I check the procedures. Even if I look over it. So, yeah. That's what I meant.
Do you have trouble with attention to details or making mistakes outside of work as well?
I don't know. Not really, I guess. It's mostly just the work stuff I mentioned.
How much distress or anxiety have these mistakes at work been causing you?
Uh... I don't know about anxiety. It's just... annoying, I guess. Having to go back and fix things. But I wouldn't say I'm distressed or anything. It's just work.
Have you noticed any impact of these work mistakes on your relationships with family or friends?

Uh... maybe a little. I mean, there's some conflict at home sometimes. They just... they say they feel like they can't count on me to follow through on things. And, uh... at work, it got to the point where my manager actually put it in a formal review. So... yeah. I guess it has an impact.
Have you been avoiding certain tasks or responsibilities at work because of these mistakes?
Uh... no, not really. I mean, I still have to do my job. I don't just... avoid things. I just do what I have to do.
Have you been feeling overwhelmed or emotionally upset by these mistakes at work?
Uh... no. Not really. I don't... I wouldn't say I get emotional about it. Like I said, it's just work. You just deal with it and move on to the next thing.
Have you been feeling bad about yourself because of these mistakes at work?
No. I mean, it's annoying when I mess up, sure, but... I don't sit around feeling bad about myself. It's just mistakes. Everyone makes them.
Have you been feeling tired lately?
Not really. I mean... just the normal amount, I guess. Nothing unusual.
Do you have any recurring thoughts or urges that you feel compelled to repeat over and over?
No. I don't... no, nothing like that.
Are you having any difficulty with daily activities outside of work?

Yeah, I guess. I mean... I forget regular life stuff too. Just... normal things. Like, I'll forget to call my attorney back, or I won't pay a bill until I get a late notice in the mail. Or... you know, I'll tell my kids I'm going to bring something home and then just completely forget to pick it up. It happens.
Do you think you would remember these things, like calling your attorney back or picking something up for your kids, if they were really important to you?
I mean... they are important. I just... I don't know. I still forget. It's not about whether I care or not.
Do you think you would be able to remember these things if someone reminded you or helped you stay on track?
Maybe. I mean... I don't really know. I guess if someone reminded me right when I needed to do it, probably. But... yeah, I'm not sure.
Do you think you would forget these things even if you were really motivated to remember them?
I don't know. Probably. Like I said, it's not really about how much I care. It just... happens.
Do you think you could remember to do something if you really wanted to?
I don't think so. I mean... wanting to do it doesn't really change anything. I just... I still forget.
Do you feel like you're putting in enough effort to remember these things?
I mean... I think I am. I try. I don't really know how to answer that, honestly. I just... I do what I can.
Do you think you would be able to remember important tasks if someone else was depending on you to get them done?
I don't know. Maybe. It's... it's hard to say. I guess it depends, but... I still mess up sometimes, even then.
Have you been experiencing these memory and attention problems for a long time?

I mean... I don't know about a long time. But... it's been a real problem since I got promoted. I moved into a supervisor role... about a year and two months ago, I think. So... mostly just since then.
Have you noticed any improvement in your ability to focus and remember things since these problems started about a year and two months ago?
No... not really. I mean, it's just... pretty much the same. I haven't noticed it getting any better.
Do you ever feel sad or down when you think about the mistakes you've made at work?
I mean... no, not really. I don't really get sad about it. It's just... it's just work, you know? I just try to move on.
